caption:
PDF exports remain unlimited and watermark-free on the free tier.

JobRez exports to PDF, Word and plain text. PDF and plain-text export are unlimited and watermark-free on the free plan, while Word document export is Pro.

Alongside clean document generation, application tracker statuses including Saved, Applied, Interviewing, Offer, and Closed are stored locally in the browser.

Build your master resume and export at https://jobrez.com.
